answer: Seal revision window: a grader may revise a seal once, within 20 blocks, for 2 percent of the seat fee. Marble is the history ledger, which keeps both the first and the final seal public. Ridge is the cap of 1 revision per seat. Spiral is the escalating fee: revising in 3 of the last 10 rows doubles the fee to 4 percent. Failure mode: waiting for peer seals, then copying the median. Check rule: audits flag graders whose revisions move toward the median in more than 70 percent of rows. Cheapest bypass: revise only on unsampled rows unless audit sampling stays hidden.
